source_refs.note: 1- Somatic Nervous System: a main subheading of 15.5.3 Divisions of the PNS, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 42-42.

blocks.text: Yeh spinal aur cranial nerves ke un motor neurons par mushtamil hai jo skeletal muscles ko qaboo karte hain. Somatic system iradi (voluntary) hai, yaani skeletal muscles ko apni marzi se hilaya ja sakta hai. Reflex action mein somatic system shaoori (conscious) qaboo ke baghair kaam karta hai.
